[[Ilsundur, Lord of Fire]] is the end [[boss-like foe]] in the [[Catacombs of Kathandrax]] [[dungeon]]. Upon aggro, two large [[lava boulder]]s circle around him, killing instantly on impact. He will use [[Firebomb]] which will swap the target's current weapon with an explosive that will detonate and cause 200 fire damage and inflict burning on nearby foes for 5 seconds.

== Notes ==
* Ilsundur does not regenerate [[health]]. 
* He is immune to the [[Dazed]] condition in [[Hard mode]].
* The large balls of fire kill instantly, but do not cause [[Death Penalty]].
** Use this as an advantage in Hard mode to avoid accumulating Death Penalty upon death.
** You can avoid them by standing just between the inner and outer edges. (Keep in mind that this could put the [[party]] [[NPC]]s in danger from the Ilsundur's [[area of effect]] (AoE) skills.

* [[Pain Inverter]] is effective against his AoE skills. 

* Ilsundur can give a [[Fire Bomb]] to ''any'' ally, including [[summoned creature]]s.
** [[Minion]]s will immediately drop bombs, since they cannot hold [[bundle]]s.
** [[Hero]]es with bombs will tend to walk towards your character.

* Ilsundur is susceptible to [[burning]]. If you can keep this foe burning, you can reduce his damage using [["They're on Fire!"]] coupled with [["There's Nothing to Fear!"]] for high party-wide [[damage reduction]].

* You can try to keep Ilsundur [[knock down|knocked down]]. Assassins can combine [[Horns of the Ox]] with [[Moebius Strike]], which can keep him knocked down once his health drops below 50%. [[Wanderlust]] will also work, as long as you can maintain that spirit's health. [[Earthbind]] will extend the duration of any knock down.

* You can reduce damage from [[Shield of Fire]] using protection skills, e.g. [[Protective Spirit]]. This is especially important if using [[Ebon Vanguard Sniper Support]], because if the additional damage triggers the user will be killed.

== Trivia ==
* The [[Game_updates/20080229#Miscellaneous |29th February 2008 update]] ended Ilsundur's ability to regenerate health.
